name: Gospel piano rolls
desc: The rolling amapiano piano - chords broken into flowing gospel arpeggios that cascade up and back through an Fmaj / Bb / Gm / C progression in F major. Sparse rolls a chord then leaves air; full is a continuous eight-note gospel run that reverses every eight cycles; peak doubles into sixteenth cascades with an octave shimmer. Contrasts the sparse-stab sibling with constant motion.

code.sparse: note("<[f3 a3 c4 e4 ~ ~ ~ ~] [bb3 d4 f4 a4 ~ ~ ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(1).gain(${gain}*.82).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.2).slow(32)).room(${room}).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(32)).orbit(4).play()
code.full: note("<[f3 c4 a3 e4 g4 e4 c4 a3] [bb3 f4 d4 a4 f4 d4 bb3 f4] [g3 d4 bb3 f4 a4 f4 d4 bb3] [e3 bb3 g3 d4 g4 d4 bb3 g3]>").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(1).gain(${gain}).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.4).slow(32)).room(sine.range(${room}*.6, ${room}).slow(64)).pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(16)).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[f3 a3 c4 e4 g4 c5 g4 e4 c4 a3 f3 a3 c4 e4 g4 e4] [bb3 d4 f4 a4 c5 f5 c5 a4 f4 d4 bb3 d4 f4 a4 c5 a4] [g3 bb3 d4 f4 a4 d5 a4 f4 d4 bb3 g3 bb3 d4 f4 a4 f4] [e3 g3 bb3 d4 g4 bb4 g4 d4 bb3 g3 e3 g3 bb3 d4 g4 d4]>").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(.85).gain(${gain}).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).room(${room}).off(1/16, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.4)).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)).orbit(4).play()
